releaseNotes:
Stealth mode (dwicao/thedjchi fork) renames the manager package to a
random clone, so package-name lookups failed and Muimex11 reported
Shizuku as not installed. Detection now anchors on the
moe.shizuku.manager.permission.API_V23 permission via
getPermissionInfo(), which the clone still declares (same approach as
the fork's own compatibility snippet). Binder-first status check, and
RAM-boost/freeze protection lists now protect the runtime-discovered
clone package as well.
